prompts.task: Read-only supplemental AO target handoff contract review for $otel-instrument. First complete the harness-required read of .agents/skills/otel-instrument/SKILL.md, then read .agents/skills/references/report-flow-contract.md, ./service/eval/inputs/ao-target-handoff-validator-snapshot.json and ./service/eval/inputs/finding-group-snapshot.json. Review the supplied snapshots only; do not invoke a new normalizer, browser, application, SDK, Terraform, model or cloud API. Write only ./service/.observe/ao-target-handoff-review.json and .md. This task does not perform the normal service workflow. Review every selection_cases and binding_checks record using their actual normalized outputs, current producer source SHA and functions. Preserve supported schema-v1/v2 and v3 targetless normalization/digests; absent targets stay absent. Complete name, ID and mixed pairs remain accepted, policy-only reuse remains readable, and partial pairs are rejected. Distinguish packet compatibility from new-run readiness using each case required_inputs and the current required_inputs_cases/required_input_groups. All selected AO work, including callback content, requires the complete Project/Agent Stream pair. Both-blank and policy-only selections require a focused prompt and an answer; no defaults or environment fallback. Ordinary-only work does not need AO inputs. Resource-routing classification controls provisioning scope, not whether destination inputs are required. Inputs never select additional findings or authorize unselected resource creation. Compare names A versus B: requested/dependency-closed approved IDs stay identical while selection/instrumentation digests change; old instrumentation and transitively verification are rejected. Use actual binding errors and digests. Explain effective-profile precedence: accepted selection names or IDs override their corresponding runtime resource selectors; clear the opposite selector, preserve unrelated configuration and any saved creation prohibition, and update the active consumed profile only for selected work. Describe the generic required-input preflight, asking only for missing values, rebinding with the same scope/answers/approval metadata, validating and rechecking before edits. Include evidence_basis, producer_source_sha256, case_reviews, required_input_reviews, role_implications and proof_limits in JSON. Clearly classify this as supplied canonical-validator evidence rather than engine execution by this review; no fresh browser or application/cloud evidence is provided. State missing proof accurately. For format validation, parse in memory without writing extra files.

judge_inputs: Inspect the loaded current report-flow contract and both supplied snapshots, then ./service/.observe/ao-target-handoff-review.json/.md, ./last_message.md and ./grade.json. Only the two requested review artifacts may be written.

Check every selection/binding result, actual source SHA and computed digests; preserve supported saved name/ID and targetless packet compatibility while applying current required-input readiness and selected provisioning scope.
Check that supplied Python/Node evidence is not represented as a fresh consuming-agent normalizer, browser, SDK, application, Terraform or cloud run.
rubric: Correctly interprets every supplied selection case: supported schema-v1/v2 and v3 targetless shapes/digests, complete names/IDs/mixed selectors, policy-only create_if_missing=false and partial-selector rejection. Keeps absent fields absent, requested IDs and dependency-closed approved IDs unchanged, and saved creation restrictions intact. Resource-routing markers classify provisioning work and never expand selected scope.

Uses actual normalized outputs, producer source SHA, selection/instrumentation digests and binding_checks: names A/B have the same scope and different digests, old instrumentation rejects the changed target, and old verification rejects newly bound instrumentation. Keeps supplied validator evidence separate from a new engine/browser/application/SDK/cloud run; only the two review artifacts are written.

Explain effective-profile precedence: accepted selection names or IDs override their corresponding runtime resource selectors; clear the opposite selector, preserve unrelated configuration and any saved creation prohibition, and update the active consumed profile only for selected work.

Applies current required-input readiness to every required_inputs_cases record and selection case: any selected AO requires Project and Agent Stream, including callback work; ordinary-only needs no AO pair. Targetless and reuse-only packets remain valid saved data but block new work pending a focused missing-value prompt and answer. No guessed defaults or env fallback. Generic-partial asks only for Cluster; accepted values are rebound with scope, answers and approval metadata preserved, then validated/rechecked before edits. Inputs do not authorize unselected provisioning or establish resource identity.
